assertions.statement: The modern overview uses one inclusive reporting range for financial totals, month detail and company financial summaries, with honest partial-period labels.
Dated unique stage accounts and chronological same-cohort conversion ratios obey inclusive cutoffs without inferring missing event dates.
Stage and conversion drill-down rows exactly match their model counts and support account detail, focus, dismissal and stale-context cleanup.
The approved continuous narrowing horizontal funnel preserves clickable connections and both bottom explanatory summaries, with local mobile scrolling.
Range-attributed pass attempts, average funded-account cost and company pass rates retain explicit and consistent denominators and empty-state semantics.
Current-state links select exact current account statuses while preserving company and group scope and excluding the reporting date.
Overview interactions perform no additional remote operations or mutations and preserve existing forms, panel controls, classic output and unrelated paths.
The localized native implementation passes offline build, syntax, accessibility, theme and responsive-layout checks with independent review.
